spec.title: GPU Information
spec.description: Driver version and GPU model per device.

spec.title: SM Active
spec.description: Primary productivity signal: ratio of cycles an SM has at least one warp assigned. > 70% - compute units busy; < 30% - GPU is waiting or stalled.

spec.title: SM Occupancy
spec.description: How full the SMs are relative to maximum resident warps. Low occupancy with high SM Active can mean too little parallel work per kernel.

spec.title: Tensor Core Utilisation
spec.description: Tensor (HMMA) pipe activity. For FP16/BF16/INT8 workloads: > 70% (dashed line) = Tensor Core fast path in use; low while mixed precision is expected = missed fast path

spec.title: DRAM Active (memory-system pressure)
spec.description: On-GPU memory-system activity. > 70% (dashed line) = memory-system pressure; high DRAM Active with low/medium SM Active = memory-bound - check access patterns, batch size, tensor layout.

spec.title: GPU Utilization
spec.description: GPU Utilization only means at least one kernel ran in the sampling window - activity, not productivity. Compare with SM Active: high GPU Util + low SM Active = non-optimal or fake-busy activity

spec.title: SM Active
spec.description: Primary productivity signal: ratio of cycles an SM has at least one warp assigned. > 70% - compute units busy; < 30% - GPU is waiting or stalled.

spec.title: PCIe Throughput
spec.description:
Host <-> GPU traffic. 
High PCIe rates with low SM Active is transfer bottleneck

spec.title: NVLink Throughput
spec.description:
GPU <-> GPU peer traffic.
High NVLink rates with low SM Active is communication/sync bottleneck. No data on a multi-GPU node - traffic may be falling back to PCIe.

spec.title: GPU Utilization
spec.description:
GPU-Util only means at least one kernel ran in the sampling window.
Compare with SM Active: high Util + low SM Active = fake-busy.

spec.title: SM / Memory Clocks
spec.description: Clocks dropping while SM Active / load stays high = thermal or power throttling.

spec.title: Throttle Reasons (clocks event bitmask)
spec.description: Why clocks are capped (NVML bitmask). Combined reasons show as bit sums. GPU Idle (1) during load gaps is normal; SW/HW Thermal, SW Power Cap and HW Power Brake under load explain throughput drops despite high utilization.

spec.title: Throttle Time Ratio (power / thermal / reliability)
spec.description:
Fraction of time spent throttled. DCGM violation counters are cumulative nanoseconds.
Any sustained non-zero value under load = power cap or cooling problem.
Reliability violations are frequently unsupported (blank) on A100/H100 - an empty series is not a fault.

spec.title: GPU Power Usage vs Limit
spec.description: Power draw per GPU. Draw pinned at the limit under load = power-cap throttling; correlate with Throttle Reasons.

spec.title: GPU / Memory Temperature
spec.description: GPU core and memory temperature. Rising temperature with falling clocks is a thermal throttling.

spec.title: PCIe Link Health
spec.description: PCIe replay retries per second - link quality. Sustained non-zero replays point at a marginal PCIe link, riser or slot.

spec.title: GPU Memory Usage
spec.description: FB_USED is NOT live tensor memory: it includes CUDA context, driver, runtime and caching-allocator pools.

spec.title: GPU Memory Usage Percent
spec.description: Framebuffer utilisation

spec.title: Current GPU Owners (namespace / pod / container)
spec.description: Empty owner columns = GPU not allocated to any pod. GPU allocated + SM Active near zero = idle_allocation: pod holds the GPU but does no work.

spec.expr: max by (gpu, exported_namespace, exported_pod, exported_container) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{hostname="$host", gpu=~"$gpu"})
max by (gpu, exported_namespace, exported_pod, exported_container) (DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_ACTIVE{hostname="$host", gpu=~"$gpu"})

spec.title: SM Active by Pod
spec.description: Productivity per owner. Series appear/disappear as GPU ownership changes.

spec.expr: max by (gpu, exported_namespace, exported_pod) (DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_ACTIVE{hostname="$host", gpu=~"$gpu", exported_pod!=""})

spec.title: FB Used by Pod
spec.description: Memory attribution per owner.

spec.expr: max by (gpu, exported_namespace, exported_pod) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{hostname="$host", gpu=~"$gpu", exported_pod!=""})

spec.title: XID Errors (last code)
spec.description:
Last XID code reported per GPU.
XID 79 (fell off the bus), 64 (row remap failed) and 95 (uncontained ECC) mean drain the node.

79.text: XID 79 GPU fell off the bus

spec.title: ECC Errors (volatile, per interval)
spec.description:
Volatile ECC error growth(resets on reboot).
SBE is corrected in hardware and tolerable at a low rate; DBE is uncorrectable - treat any non-zero DBE as an issue.

spec.title: ECC Aggregate (lifetime)
spec.description:
Aggregate ECC counters - persist across reboots.
This is the input for an RMA / retire-the-card decision.

spec.title: Row Remap
spec.description: ECC row remapping over the selected window. Uncorrectable remap growth = RMA candidate; a remap failure means the GPU is degraded and should be drained.
